description: This file contains the code-behind for the MCQExam.aspx page in an online examination system. It handles loading multiple-choice questions from a database based on the selected course, displays them to the user, manages the timer for the exam, processes user responses, calculates the score, and saves results to the database. It also provides navigation and session management functionalities.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Partial class for the MCQExam ASP.NET page handling exam operations, question retrieval, scoring, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; loads questions from the database based on the selected course stored in session, initializes the timer.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the user's score based on selected answers, stores the result in the database, and navigates to the results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and navigates to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Handles the exam countdown timer; displays remaining time and triggers actions when time expires.
